title: Curator Archive.org pull
description: Phase 6 / Bet 5 slice 7 (2026-05-17). Pulls candidate videos from Archive.org's public-domain film + lecture + archival collections via the unauthenticated advancedsearch.php endpoint. First multi-source ingestion script after slice 1.5 (YouTube RSS) - Archive.org is Tier 1 in the speaktube multi-source rollout because it's the best ethos fit (no engagement algorithm, public-domain long tail, no auth, no rate limits). Emits rows in the canonical 14-column curator-candidate schema with `source="archive_org"`, so the composer's scored-candidates feeder picks them up alongside YouTube candidates with one SPQL query. yt-dlp resolves https://archive.org/details/<id> URLs natively at speaktube playback time. Default query filters mediatype:movies (films + recorded lectures) and sorts by publicdate desc (newest first) to surface fresh additions. Cron default `0 4 * * *` runs once before the composer's 05:00 PT fire. Operators can tune `ARCHIVE_ORG_QUERY` (the search filter) and `MAX_ITEMS_PER_RUN` for narrower or broader exploration. Each row's `channel_id` is `archive_org:<creator_slug>` so the namespace doesn't collide with YouTube UC IDs; archive.org items naturally land in the composer's growth/exploration slot (no watch_history match → growth_score=1.0, interest_score gets re-scored by the topic-vectors hook).
